newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland opposes coal price rise - industry minister.
newsitem.headline: Poland opposes coal price rise - industry minister.

text.p: The Polish government will not agree to the 20-percent rise in coal prices requested by coal firms on Monday because it would lift electrical energy prices and threaten inflation targets, the industry minister said.

"A rise in (coal prices) as the miners want would lift electrical energy prices by at least 17 percent. The government won't agree to this," Klemens Scierski told a news conference on Tuesday after a cabinet meeting.
Scierski said the move would spur inflation and hinder the government from carrying out this year's budget, which envisages 17 percent price growth in 1996.
He said talks with the heads of coal firms and power stations on lowering the rises were already underway.
